description: Fetch the eSIM QR code(s) for an order, to show the buyer directly. Pass the checkout_session_id from create_checkout. Returns a clear `status`: 'awaiting_payment' (buyer has NOT paid — tell them to pay), 'processing' (paid, eSIM still provisioning — retry in ~30s), 'manual_review' (paid, activation paused for security review; ask buyer to contact support@altesim.com with the order reference), 'ready' (returns the QR image(s) + ICCID(s) to display), 'expired', 'refunded', or 'failed'. Use the status to tell the buyer exactly what's happening — never assume payment succeeded.

checkout_session_id.description: The checkout_session_id from create_checkout (Stripe session id).

name: get_qr_code
